# API Reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Core

Core density classification and reporting. `DensityClassifierFull` wraps the Rust-accelerated core with embedding generation, DataFrame I/O, and LLM-based labeling.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [DensityClassifierFull](DensityClassifierFull.qmd#dyf.DensityClassifierFull) | Density Classifier using PCA-based LSH. |

## Tree Methods

Hierarchical tree construction for multi-resolution analysis of embeddings.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [build_pca_tree](build_pca_tree.qmd#dyf.build_pca_tree) | Build a PCA bisection tree over embeddings. |
| [cut_tree_to_labels](cut_tree_to_labels.qmd#dyf.cut_tree_to_labels) | Cut PCA tree at n_clusters and return point labels array. |
| [extract_boundary_persistence](extract_boundary_persistence.qmd#dyf.extract_boundary_persistence) | Identify points that persist as boundary across multiple tree depths. |
| [boundary_persistence_scores](boundary_persistence_scores.qmd#dyf.boundary_persistence_scores) | Compute depth-weighted boundary persistence bridge scores. |
| [build_dyf_tree](build_dyf_tree.qmd#dyf.build_dyf_tree) | Build a DYF recursive tree over embeddings. |
| [refine_dyf_tree](refine_dyf_tree.qmd#dyf.refine_dyf_tree) | Re-split incoherent tree leaves with rotated LSH seeds. |
| [cut_dyf_tree_to_labels](cut_dyf_tree_to_labels.qmd#dyf.cut_dyf_tree_to_labels) | Cut DYF tree into flat cluster labels using agglomerative merge. |
| [refine_clusters](refine_clusters.qmd#dyf.refine_clusters) | Post-processing safety net: eject periphery from incoherent clusters. |

## Retrieval (RAG)

Bridge-aware retrieval, anchor selection, and ontology construction.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [BridgeIndex](BridgeIndex.qmd#dyf.BridgeIndex) | Two-tier RAG index using bridge-based anchors for efficient retrieval. |
| [find_super_connectors](find_super_connectors.qmd#dyf.find_super_connectors) | Find super connectors: points with high centrality in both global and local |
| [select_orthogonal_anchors](select_orthogonal_anchors.qmd#dyf.select_orthogonal_anchors) | Select k maximally spread anchors using greedy farthest-point sampling. |
| [diversify_by_facet](diversify_by_facet.qmd#dyf.diversify_by_facet) | Select k items from k different semantic facets (buckets). |
| [get_kmeans_init](get_kmeans_init.qmd#dyf.get_kmeans_init) | Get bridge-seeded initial centroids for k-means/IVF index construction. |
| [compute_neighbor_diversity](compute_neighbor_diversity.qmd#dyf.compute_neighbor_diversity) | Compute neighbor diversity for each point. |
| [compute_hub_score](compute_hub_score.qmd#dyf.compute_hub_score) | Compute hub score for each point in the embedding space. |
| [mine_dag_chains](mine_dag_chains.qmd#dyf.mine_dag_chains) | Mine DAG (directed acyclic graph) structures from embedding space. |
| [build_dag_taxonomy](build_dag_taxonomy.qmd#dyf.build_dag_taxonomy) | Build a navigable DAG taxonomy from embedding space. |
| [build_unified_ontology](build_unified_ontology.qmd#dyf.build_unified_ontology) | Build a unified ontology that covers both dense and sparse embedding regions. |
| [build_rog_ontology](build_rog_ontology.qmd#dyf.build_rog_ontology) | Recursive Ontological Generation (ROG). |

Dataclasses returned by RAG and analysis functions.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [SuperConnectorResult](SuperConnectorResult.qmd#dyf.SuperConnectorResult) | Result of finding super connectors in an embedding space. |

| [FacetDiverseResult](FacetDiverseResult.qmd#dyf.FacetDiverseResult) | Result of facet-based diversification. |
| [DAGChain](DAGChain.qmd#dyf.DAGChain) | A single DAG chain representing a hierarchical path. |
| [DAGMiningResult](DAGMiningResult.qmd#dyf.DAGMiningResult) | Result of DAG mining on an embedding space. |
| [DAGTaxonomy](DAGTaxonomy.qmd#dyf.DAGTaxonomy) | A navigable DAG taxonomy extracted from embedding space. |
| [UnifiedOntologyResult](UnifiedOntologyResult.qmd#dyf.UnifiedOntologyResult) | Result of building a unified ontology from embedding space. |
| [HubScoreResult](HubScoreResult.qmd#dyf.HubScoreResult) | Result of hub score computation. |
| [ROGLayer](ROGLayer.qmd#dyf.ROGLayer) | A single layer in the ROG hierarchy. |
| [ROGResult](ROGResult.qmd#dyf.ROGResult) | Result of Recursive Ontological Generation. |

## Re-ranking

Re-rank search results with diversity and bridge awareness.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [rerank_standard](rerank_standard.qmd#dyf.rerank_standard) | Take the top-k most similar candidates. |
| [rerank_mmr](rerank_mmr.qmd#dyf.rerank_mmr) | Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranking. |
| [rerank_bridge_boost](rerank_bridge_boost.qmd#dyf.rerank_bridge_boost) | Re-rank by blending similarity with normalized bridge score. |
| [rerank_bridge_mmr](rerank_bridge_mmr.qmd#dyf.rerank_bridge_mmr) | MMR with bridge-weighted diversity and optional meta-cluster awareness. |

## Chunk Analysis

Analyze chunk redundancy, document spread, and cluster quality.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [DocSpread](DocSpread.qmd#dyf.DocSpread) | Per-document chunk distribution across LSH buckets. |
| [chunk_redundancy](chunk_redundancy.qmd#dyf.chunk_redundancy) | Count same-doc siblings sharing each point's bucket. |
| [deduplicate_chunks](deduplicate_chunks.qmd#dyf.deduplicate_chunks) | Boolean mask keeping one representative per (bucket, doc) pair. |
| [doc_spread](doc_spread.qmd#dyf.doc_spread) | Per-document chunk distribution analysis. |
| [cluster_quality](cluster_quality.qmd#dyf.cluster_quality) | Identify meta/structural clusters from neighbor coherence. |
| [neighbor_coherence](neighbor_coherence.qmd#dyf.neighbor_coherence) | Measure how coherent each point's neighborhood is. |

## Lazy Index

Memory-mapped tree index with FlatBuffers + Arrow IPC. Build indexes with `write_lazy_index`, search with `LazyIndex`, and use adaptive probing for margin-aware probe counts.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [LazyIndex](LazyIndex.qmd#dyf.LazyIndex) | Memory-mapped DYF index for instant-start query serving. |
| [write_lazy_index](write_lazy_index.qmd#dyf.write_lazy_index) | Write a DYF lazy index file (FlatBuffers tree + Arrow IPC leaf data). |
| [rewrite_lazy_index](rewrite_lazy_index.qmd#dyf.rewrite_lazy_index) | Rewrite a .dyf file with additional stored fields and/or metadata. |
| [split_dyf3](split_dyf3.qmd#dyf.split_dyf3) | Split a DYF3 file into chunks for transport (e.g. GitHub Pages). |
| [from_faiss](from_faiss.qmd#dyf.from_faiss) | Build a dyf lazy index file from a FAISS IVF index. |
| [SearchResult](SearchResult.qmd#dyf.SearchResult) | Search result with indices, scores, and optional stored fields. |
| [AdaptiveProbeConfig](AdaptiveProbeConfig.qmd#dyf.AdaptiveProbeConfig) | Configuration for adaptive probe count based on routing margin. |

## Fisher Weighting

Per-dimension Fisher ratio weighting for supervised embedding refinement.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [compute_fisher_weights](compute_fisher_weights.qmd#dyf.compute_fisher_weights) | Compute sqrt(Fisher ratio) per dimension, L2-normalized. |
| [apply_fisher_weights](apply_fisher_weights.qmd#dyf.apply_fisher_weights) | Multiply embeddings by per-dimension weights. |

## Split Keywords

TF-IDF keyword extraction from DYF tree splits. Each PCA split naturally separates vocabularies — these functions extract discriminative terms per split side without LLM calls.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [compute_split_keywords](compute_split_keywords.qmd#dyf.compute_split_keywords) | Compute discriminative TF-IDF keywords for each side of each tree split. |
| [compute_embedding_keywords](compute_embedding_keywords.qmd#dyf.compute_embedding_keywords) | Compute discriminative keywords by projecting term embeddings onto split hyperplanes. |
| [label_clusters_frequency](label_clusters_frequency.qmd#dyf.label_clusters_frequency) | Label clusters using TF-IDF token frequency (no LLM). |
| [build_tree_maps](build_tree_maps.qmd#dyf.build_tree_maps) | Extract tree structure, children_map, and leaf_batches from a LazyIndex. |
| [collect_descendant_indices](collect_descendant_indices.qmd#dyf.collect_descendant_indices) | Recursively collect all item indices under a node. |
| [compute_domain_stopwords](compute_domain_stopwords.qmd#dyf.compute_domain_stopwords) | Words appearing in >threshold fraction of titles. Corpus-level stop words. |
| [format_split_path](format_split_path.qmd#dyf.format_split_path) | Return the keyword path for a single item from root to leaf. |
| [tokenize](tokenize.qmd#dyf.tokenize) | Lowercase, extract words of 3+ chars, filter stop words. |
| [TextDiversityReport](TextDiversityReport.qmd#dyf.TextDiversityReport) | Result of text diversity assessment for a collection of titles. |
| [assess_text_diversity](assess_text_diversity.qmd#dyf.assess_text_diversity) | Cheaply assess whether a title collection has enough diversity for LLM labeling. |

## Cluster Tree

Connect BIRCH spatial clusters to DYF tree nodes for deterministic cluster naming.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [build_cluster_tree_dag](build_cluster_tree_dag.qmd#dyf.build_cluster_tree_dag) | Build a DAG connecting BIRCH clusters to tree nodes they overlap with. |
| [compute_sibling_keywords](compute_sibling_keywords.qmd#dyf.compute_sibling_keywords) | Compute contrastive TF-IDF keywords for clusters sharing tree parents. |
| [derive_path_labels](derive_path_labels.qmd#dyf.derive_path_labels) | Derive deterministic path labels for each cluster from the DAG. |
| [format_cluster_context](format_cluster_context.qmd#dyf.format_cluster_context) | Format cluster context for an LLM labeling prompt. |

## Agglomeration

Merge DYF tree leaves into coarser groups via linkage or community detection.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [agglomerate_tree_leaves](agglomerate_tree_leaves.qmd#dyf.agglomerate_tree_leaves) | Agglomerate DYF tree leaves into ~n_groups using embedding centroids. |
| [louvain_cluster_leaves](louvain_cluster_leaves.qmd#dyf.louvain_cluster_leaves) | Cluster tree leaves via centroid KNN + Louvain community detection. |
| [merge_to_max_k](merge_to_max_k.qmd#dyf.merge_to_max_k) | Merge communities to ≤max_k using complete linkage on community centroids. |

Hierarchical taxonomy graphs, label coarsening, and multi-level Fisher weighting.
